dotz.blurb: A coding dashboard for directing work to a team of AI coding agents. Rust core, Tauri shell.

sophos.blurb: A Windows desktop app around Prime Intellect's open-source Prime Agent. The shell and UI are mine; the runtime is theirs.

megavibe.blurb: A native Linux workspace for coding agents: terminals, notes, plans and on-device voice planning on one board.

industry-ai-suite.blurb: Ten local, read-only review tools sharing one evidence layer with source citations. No send, post or trade actions.

open-ro.blurb: Open-source, local-first AI development studio for Roblox projects. Just started.

credits: Sophos builds on Prime Intellect's open-source Prime Agent (PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent, MIT). Megavibe is a Linux implementation based on Hypervibe's public product information. dotz bundles vendored Open Design content (Apache-2.0). DeepSeek Harness is an open-source project by the deepseek-ai organization (deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, MIT); DSH Fleet is an independent, unofficial plugin for it and is not affiliated with DeepSeek.
intro: I build applied AI and developer tools, around one idea: the AI does the work and a person signs off.
